name: update_product_state
title: Update product (offer) lifecycle state
description:
*Rate limit: 100 requests / 10 seconds per shop. See [Rate limiting](/guides/rate-limiting).*

Transitions the product between `PUBLIC` and `HIDDEN`. Use `DELETE /products/{productId}` to archive — `ARCHIVED` is not reachable here. The sold-out (`available`) flag is preserved; flip it via `PUT /products/{productId}/availability`. Idempotent: no-op if the product is already in the requested state.

bodySchema.description: Request to transition a product (offer) lifecycle state. Only `PUBLIC` and `HIDDEN` are reachable via this endpoint — use `DELETE /products/{productId}` to archive.

state.description: Target lifecycle state. `PUBLIC` makes the product visible on the storefront; `HIDDEN` keeps it unlisted. The sold-out (`available`) flag is preserved across the transition — use `PUT /products/{productId}/availability` to flip it.

bodySchema.title: Update Product State V1Request

name: create_product
title: Create a product
description:
*Rate limit: 5 requests / minute per shop. See [Rate limiting](/guides/rate-limiting).*

Creates a product from a design or a digital product.

bodySchema.description: Request to create a product. The shape is discriminated by the `type` field.

allOf.description: Request to create a product. The shape is discriminated by the `type` field.
allOf.title: Create Product Request

productTemplateId.description: Id of the product template to render the design onto, from `GET /open-api/v1.0/product-templates`.

regions.description: Design regions to place on the product. Each region references a registered media image by id (register it via `POST /open-api/v1.0/media/images` and pass the returned id as `imageId`).

items.description: A product region paired with the registered media image to render on it.

region.description: Name of the product region to place the image on, e.g. `front` or `back`.

imageId.description: Id of a registered media-library image to render on the region. Register the image first via `POST /open-api/v1.0/media/images` and pass the returned id here.

placementId.description: Placement to target when `placementStrategy` is `PLACEMENT_ID`. Required for that strategy and ignored by the others.

placementStrategy.description:
How the image is placed on the region. Defaults to `AUTO` when omitted, and takes precedence over `placementId`/`fillAllPlacements`.
- `AUTO` — let the renderer decide using the product's automation defaults (its preferred placement, or fill-all for products like mugs/stickers).
- `FILL_ALL` — apply the image to every placement in the region.
- `FULL_REGION` — render the image across the full region, skipping the preferred placement.
- `PLACEMENT_ID` — target the single placement named by `placementId` (required for this strategy).

items.title: Product Design Region

colors.description: Colors to render. Defaults to all available product colors when omitted. Values not offered by the product are ignored; the request is rejected with 400 if none of the supplied colors are available.

sizes.description: Sizes to include. Defaults to all available product sizes when omitted. Values not offered by the product are ignored; the request is rejected with 400 if none of the supplied sizes are available. When both colors and sizes are supplied, the request is also rejected with 400 if no requested color/size combination is an available variant.

profitMargin.description: Profit margin in USD applied on top of the base cost.

publishOnCreate.description: Publish the product immediately on creation. Defaults to false (product stays hidden).

oneOf.description: Create a product by running the design pipeline: renders each region's registered image into mockups and creates a purchasable product. The product is created hidden unless `publishOnCreate` is true.
oneOf.title: Create Design Product Request

allOf.description: Request to create a product. The shape is discriminated by the `type` field.
allOf.title: Create Product Request

price.description: Price set by the creator, in USD.

publishOnCreate.description: Publish the product immediately on creation. Defaults to false (product stays hidden).

oneOf.description: Create a digital product with a creator-set price in USD and digital fulfillment. Attach files and images via the /products/{productId}/digital-files and /products/{productId}/images endpoints.
oneOf.title: Create Digital Product Request
